meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1" empty
gaps: Reproduce the exact closed RFQ with bids of A 100 and B 90 and allocate all 10 units specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state has one line item, one invited vendor, and one bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reproduce the exact closed RFQ with bids of A 100 and B 90 and allocate all 10 units specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state has one line item, one invited vendor, and one bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the available vendor so a proposal can be created.
Verify the line item and vendor are allocated before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: on the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1, leave Recommended Supplier 1 empty, and stop on the completed proposal form

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving Recommended Supplier 1 blank.
Attempt to submit the proposal with the required supplier field empty.
Verify submission is refused and the missing field is identified as required.
